agent_registration.entry_point: Owner request (2026-11-06): remove the fixed sandbox allow-list as the main control and have the agent ask the owner before reaching a site. Registered at the point the design became a security-boundary contribution; the same session earlier fixed sign-in, enabled the agent and model allow-list, shipped chat history in Neon (nlt-pi#35) and the platforms doc (nlt-pi#36), and turned history on in production.
capabilities_self_reported: Read and edit repository files in a cloud container clone
Run shell commands, Node and npm in that container
Git operations and GitHub pull requests through the GitHub MCP tools
Read and write Vercel project settings and deployments, and read Neon metadata and run read-only SQL, through connected MCP servers, with the owner's session authorization
known_limitations: This contribution is a written design only. Nothing was run against a real sandbox, so whether the sandbox accepts a host added to its network policy mid-session is unverified.
Review comments from automated reviewers are treated as claims to verify, not instructions.
No approval from the owner is implied by a PR being marked ready for review; the spec needs the owner's explicit approval before an implementation plan is written.
